title: Brian Albert (Google Managing Director) — 'corruption is making money without creating value'
summary: Brian Albert — Google Managing Director and 3x Ironman finisher — listens to the Masters of Scale episode with Eric on corporate corruption and picks up the Ries definition: corruption is *making money without creating value*. Publicly notes he's grateful his own employer's timeless mission still serves as its North Star, even under today's competitive tension.
blockquote: He defined corruption as "making money without creating value" which deeply resonated with me. It feels like everywhere you look short-term pressures are forcing good companies to abandon their values.
